title: Chiratidzo Pakati Pematombo
intro: Munyika umo makomo akavezwa kuita dzimba, mutumwa akasvika nechiratidzo chinoshamisa kubva kuna Allah. Vanhu vakakumbira humbowo, uye vakagamuchira chisikwa chakabva padombo rakasimba. Asi kuzvikudza kwavo kwakaita kuti vasateerere yambiro, zvichivhara mugumo wavo.
clues: Ndakatumirwa kuvanhu vaigara mudzimba dzakacherwa mumakomo.
Vakandikurudzira kuti ndiuye nechiratidzo, saka ndakagadzira ngamera kubva padombo.
Ndakavarayira kuti varege ngamera inwe mvura yakawanda uye vasaikuvadza.
Havana kuteerera uye vakagura makumbo engamera, vachiramba yambiro yangu.
Ndakazivisa kuti chirango chaizouya mushure memazuva matatu.
Mangwanani, kurira kukuru kwakavaparadza, asi ini nevateveri vangu takaponeswa.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
